criteria.statement: A reload or new browser document renders a signer-first cached/stale PostgreSQL projection with event ID, hash, sanitized source relay, and last-sync instead of blank canonical truth.
Loaded-live, loaded-cached/stale, unavailable, never-configured, and explicitly signed empty policy are visually and semantically distinct.

Apply is disabled while canonical truth is loading or unavailable; definitive unavailable truth can unlock it only with an explicit checked confirmation and a valid non-secret change/incident reference.

The signed Apply request carries an expected projection head or replacement confirmation separately from canonical policy; the service rejects stale heads and false unavailable claims, and publishes correlated service-authored confirmation evidence before canonical mutation.
Compatible legacy browser relay override values migrate to a versioned local/noncanonical envelope and credential/query/fragment-bearing values never enter browser storage or logs.
